overview.about: The Honda LPGA Thailand is a long-running stop on the tour's Asian swing, played at the Siam Country Club near Pattaya. Tropical heat and a strong Asian following make it one of the most popular international weeks on the LPGA.
overview.nextEvent: The next Honda LPGA Thailand is played at Siam Country Club in Chonburi. Heat, humidity and enthusiastic local crowds shape one of the tour's favourite Asian stops.
